''See also: [[Jak Escalon Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Jak Escalon, also known as Jak, is the current president of the [[Escalon Company]], a mid-level interplanetary corporation. Despite inheriting the business, he is described as being ill-suited for leadership, appearing thin and nervous with premature graying in his hair. He is characterized as an arms dealer who lacks the remorseless nature of a killer, though he frequently struggles with anxiety and indecision. Jak's position is complicated by his relationship with [[Omega]], the company's founder and a hired murderer who publicly poses as Jak's uncle to hide his immortality. While Jak is the technical head of the company, he often relies on [[Omega]] as a last resort during crises. His legal standing is precarious, as he has faced arrest warrants from [[the Advocates]] for charges involving smuggling and the illegal manufacturing of weapons.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Jak is a thin, weaselly man who is almost fifty years old. He has gray hair at his temples and a nervous expression tattooed onto his face.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As an arms dealer and the president of a galactic corporation, Jak has been accused of smuggling and illegal weapon manufacturing. He is uncooperative with Nafir Nuren.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Jak is the son of [[Aila Escalon|Aila]] and the grandson of [[Omega]]. He is also the nephew of the narrator.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Engineer}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|Jak Escalon serves as the President of the [[Escalon Company]] and is the grandson of [[Omega]], though he is publicly recognized as [[Omega]]'s nephew.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c22">''The Engineer'', chapter 22</ref> Following a telephone call with [[Omega]], Jak was identified as either a family member or a potential combatant.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c22" /><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c41">''The Engineer'', chapter 41</ref> He faced accusations of smuggling and the illegal manufacturing of weapons, yet he remained uncooperative with Nafir Nuren.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c43">''The Engineer'', chapter 43</ref> Ultimately, [[Omega]] scooped up Jak.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c45">''The Engineer'', chapter 45</ref>}}
